title: 生涯学習特別講義(ポジティブ心理学と組織活性化)(春期集中講義)

keywords: Positive Psychology 2.revitalization of the company 3.positive leadership 4.work-engagement
educationalGoal: Learning about the basic methods of revitalizing the company based on Positive Psychology, which are attracting attention in the business world these days. This course demonstrate the new leadership required in the future to revitalize the work environment through some activities.
advice: In our society, where labor shortages due to the declining birthrate and increasing aging population are obvious challenges, the success or failure of a business is greatly related not only to 「customer satisfaction」and also to 「employee satisfaction」. While the question is how to build a “workplace that makes you want to work” in order to increase the productivity of a company, it is necessary to develop leaders who also improve the physical and mental health of employees in the field of labor shortage. The key is how to create a workplace culture in which employees want to work for a long time. In the United States, attention has already been paid to methods related to environmental adjustment that utilize Positive Psychology(Posi Psy) to improve the well-being of employees, and the state of leadership necessary for organizational revitalization. Therefore, in this course, we will focus on organizational activation, using Positive Psychology, and outline the following three points. 1. Positive Psychology 2. positive organization theory 3. Appreciative Inquiry (AI) Some excersises based on Posi Psy are included.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic concepts and terms of Positive Psychology.
Be able to explain what is positive leadership.
Be able to explain how work engagement can be enhanced.
Be able to explain the basic concepts and terms of Appreciative Inquiry.
Be able to explain how to practice Appreciative Inquiry.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to correctly understand and explain the basic concepts and terms of Positive Psychology. You will also understand positive leadership and Appreciative Inquiry based on Positive Psychology, and put into practice how to use them to revitalize your organization.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand and explain the basic concepts and terms of Positive Psychology. You can also understand and explain positive leadership and Appreciative Inquiry based on Positive Psychology.In addition, consider and explain how to utilize them to avtivate the organization.
